title.zh: 为执行第842号共和国法关于公立学校官员、教师及公立学校局和其他福利城教师等学校人员的规定，拨款一千七百万比索用于1955–1956财年的法案
title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Seventeen Million Pesos to Carry Out the Provisions of Republic Act Numbered Eight Hundred Forty-Two with Respect to Public School Officials, Teachers and Other School Personnel of the Bureau of Public Schools and Welfareville Teachers, for the Fiscal Year 1955-1956
title.orig: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Seventeen Million Pesos to Carry Out the Provisions of Republic Act Numbered Eight Hundred Forty-Two with Respect to Public School Officials, Teachers and Other School Personnel of the Bureau of Public Schools and Welfareville Teachers, for the Fiscal Year 1955-1956
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp kinh phí 17.000.000 peso để thực hiện các quy định của Đạo luật Cộng hòa số 842 đối với cán bộ, giáo viên và nhân viên trường học thuộc Cục Trường học Công lập và giáo viên Trường Phúc lợi Thành phố cho năm tài chính 1955–1956
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดสรรงบประมาณจำนวน17000000เปโซเพื่อดำเนินการตามบทบัญญัติแห่งพระราชบัญญัติสาธารณรัฐฉบับที่842ว่าด้วยเจ้าหน้าที่โรงเรียนรัฐบาลครูและบุคลากรทางการศึกษาอื่นๆของสำนักโรงเรียนรัฐบาลและครูโรงเรียนเวล์แฟร์วิลล์สำหรับปีงบประมาณ พ.ศ.2498–2499
title.id: Undang-Undang mengalokasikan dana sejumlah 17.000.000 peso untuk melaksanakan ketentuan Undang-Undang Republik Nomor 842 mengenai pejabat sekolah umum, guru, dan tenaga kependidikan lainnya di Biro Sekolah Umum dan guru Sekolah Welfareville untuk tahun anggaran 1955–1956
title.ms: Akta memperuntukkan jumlah 17.000.000 peso bagi pelaksanaan peruntukan Akta Republik No. 842 berkenaan pegawai sekolah awam, guru dan kakitangan sekolah lain di Jabatan Sekolah Awam dan guru Sekolah Welfareville bagi tahun perakaunan 1955–1956

text.en: The sum of seventeen million pesos, or so much thereof as may be necessary, is appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to carry out the provisions of Republic Act Numbered Eight hundred forty-two with respect to public school officials, teachers and other school personnel of the Bureau of Public Schools and Welfareville teachers, for the fiscal year 1955-1956, subject to the availability of funds as certified by the Commissioner of the Budget, the Secretary of Finance and the Auditor General: Provided, That this appropriation shall be given top priority. The necessary sum to carry out the provisions of said Act in succeeding years shall be included in the annual General Appropriation Acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 1, 1955.
